observations: body L7, L20, L24: «خُوصِيٌّ» (L7) has a shadda and over it a dammatan on its yāʾ. The hamza of «جُزْءٌ» (L20) is cast with its dammatan (two small loops on its head), as that of «اِخْتِفَاءٌ» on p. 330; the hamza of «أدِلَّاءُ» (L24) with a damma (one loop), as that of «الحَوَّاءُ» on p. 329, and its alif has no fatha.
body L12, L20: «62-69», «69-80» (L12) and «19-20» (L20) are printed with a hyphen; the other ranges of the page have an en dash.
body L21, L34: the digits 2 of «٢٢٤–٢٢٥» (L21) and the last digit of «١١٢» (L34) have one crest each (2.9-3.0 points); a 3 measures 4.6-4.7 points on this page.
body L25, L26: a small mark (3.6 by 1.9 points) is printed between the lines, below the 1 of «314» (L25) and above the Syriac word of L26; not transcribed.
body L26: «ܡܕܰܒܪܳܢܳܐ» is printed in Serṭo type with Greek-letter vowels: the pthoḥo (a small A) over the dālath, the zqofo (a small o) over the rīsh and the nūn.
notes_left L1-L3: the yāʾ of «بِلَّوْريّة», «كُحْلِيّة», «سَمَاويّة» and «وَرْديّة» bears a shadda without a vowel; only «كُحْلِيّة» has a kasra under the letter before it.
notes_right L4: the ς of «τῆς» is printed in two fragments, like a colon.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
